whatIs.title: What is WellSpent?
whatIs.body: WellSpent is an income-first budgeting app. Declare your income, plan your fixed expenses and savings, then track your variable spending as the month unfolds. The running total always shows what you have left — no surprises at month end.

showcase.title: See it before you sign up
showcase.subtitle: A budget you can actually read, from the plan down to the last coffee.

overview.title: Know where the money actually went
overview.desc: Every category with its real spend next to what you planned, biggest first. Anything over plan is marked in red with the amount you went over by — no hunting through rows to find the problem.

plan.title: Decide the numbers before the month does
plan.desc: Set a planned amount per category and per person. That plan becomes the line everything else is measured against, so overspending is obvious the day it happens rather than at the end of the month.

fixed.title: Rent, subscriptions, and every other bill
fixed.desc: Recurring bills are templates: one transaction appears each period automatically, split into unpaid and paid so what's still outstanding is always at the top. Loans and instalment plans can carry an end date and stop on their own.

variable.title: Day-to-day spending, in seconds
variable.desc: Add a spend with its category, payment method and who it belongs to. Search, sort, or filter down to just the categories that have gone over plan — and exclude a one-off like a reimbursement without deleting it.

highlights.title: Two things a spreadsheet won't do
highlights.subtitle: The parts of WellSpent people tell us they didn't expect.

shared.title: A budget isn't a one-person job
shared.desc: Invite your partner or housemates by email and give each person a role — admin, collaborator, or view-only. Income, payment methods and spending are attributed per person, so everyone works from the same numbers instead of comparing notes at the end of the month.

matching.title: Your bank feed, already reconciled
matching.desc: Connect a bank and imported transactions are scored against the fixed expenses you already planned — amount, merchant name, payment method, category. A confident match waits in a To Review tab for one tap. Confirm a merchant once and identical charges match themselves from then on.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Grouped the way the app is — so you know what you're getting.

plan.title: Plan
plan.summary: Set the numbers, then watch them play out.

overview.title: Expense Overview
overview.desc: Actual spending per category with a chart, a collapsible per-person breakdown, and a clear marker on anything that went over plan.

plan.title: Expense Plan
plan.desc: Planned amounts per category and per person, sorted so your biggest commitments are always at the top.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.summary: Everything you spend, fixed or variable.

fixed.title: Fixed expenses
fixed.desc: Recurring bill templates that spawn one transaction per period, with optional end dates so loans and instalment plans stop on their own.

variable.title: Variable spending
variable.desc: Fast entry for day-to-day spending, with a spent/received toggle, per-person attribution, and the option to exclude a transaction from totals without deleting it.

matching.title: Auto-matching
matching.desc: Imported bank transactions are scored against your fixed expenses and queued for a single tap of confirmation. Merchants you've confirmed before match on their own.

reports.title: Reports
reports.summary: Historical views across budget periods. Not built yet — we'd rather say so than mock it up.

budget.title: Your budget
budget.summary: The pieces a budget is built from.

income.title: Income sources
income.desc: Salary, hourly, freelance or one-off — declared up front and per person, so every plan starts from what you actually earn.

savings.title: Savings
savings.desc: Recurring savings goals per person. In the US, a tax reserve is maintained for you from your filing status, income and payment frequency.

categories.title: Categories
categories.desc: Sensible categories out of the box, plus your own for anything that doesn't fit. Renaming one updates every transaction that used it.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.desc: Name each card, account or wallet and attribute it to a person, so shared spending is never ambiguous.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.desc: Be told in-app or by email when someone adds a transaction, when spending crosses a threshold you chose, or when a new period begins.

plaid.title: Bank sync
plaid.desc: Connect a US bank through Plaid and let transactions import themselves. Available on paid plans; US accounts only for now.

useCases.title: Use Cases
useCases.subtitle: Built for real budgeting situations.
useCases.item1Desc: Share one budget with different income sources and spending per person. Everyone sees the full picture.
useCases.item2Desc: Variable income? Set aside a tax reserve automatically based on your filing status and payment frequency.
useCases.item3Desc: Whether you're saving for a house or just trying to spend less on eating out — WellSpent helps you plan before you spend.

about.title: About Us
about.body: WellSpent was built by a small team that got tired of budgeting tools that only show you what happened — not what's about to happen. We believe the best time to manage your money is before you spend it.
